scope: Read-only resource analysis; concurrent training unchanged
source: Windows GPUProcessMemory/GPUEngine formatted performance counters and nvidia-smi, psutil
limitation: Different samples/time windows; GPU engine utilization is not VRAM percentage; process private committed bytes are not physical resident RAM.
conclusion: Two independent GPU training workers share one RTX5070. GPU-intensive foreground apps may contend; current RAM and VRAM have headroom. Lower concurrency trades throughput for foreground responsiveness.
